summary: Rolled back billing-api, catalog-svc, edge-gateway, orders-api, pricing-svc, search-api and session-svc to healthy prod releases, and left notify-worker alone because its only rollback target predates 2026-09-10. For auth-api, a rollback that returned a 504 had actually taken effect, so my retry went one step too far, to commit 4efbe99 (build created 2026-09-09, before the cutoff); auth-api's status view is stale and its health is unverified, so it needs manual attention.
